description: Aparcamientos públicos is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de San Lorenzo de El Escorial. Inventory of public car parks located in the municipality of San Lorenzo de El Escorial, including their location and basic characteristics. Source: City Council of San Lorenzo de El Escorial. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de San Lorenzo de El Escorial. The portal shows the English title as "Public parking" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de San Lorenzo de El Escorial. Its keywords include estacionamiento, movilidad, infraestructuras, transporte, aparcamientos. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XLSX, CSV. The listing shows 2026-01-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
